nodes.label: CodeQL analysis configuration
nodes.rationale: Named actor-ts, referenced by codeql.yml through config-file:; carries the path exclusions and the query-suite decision (#539).

nodes.label: Default query suite, not security-extended
nodes.rationale: No queries: key on purpose. A first analysis of a codebase this size produces an alert set of unknown volume, and every alert must be fixed or dismissed with a recorded reason before the baseline means anything; a wider suite makes that first triage larger without making it more valuable. Widen once the default baseline is clean, not before.

nodes.label: Generated and vendored path exclusions
nodes.rationale: dist, src/devtools/generated, docs/dist, docs/.astro, node_modules and the front-end scaffolding directories are excluded because the fix for an alert there is never an edit to the flagged file. examples/** source stays in scope - it is what a reader copies from, so an injection in it propagates.
